title: Answer: no account of physical space, and 3D space is one of many spaces an agent navigates

statements.text: Basal cognition takes no position on what space is in physics. Ordinary 3D space is one of the spaces agents act in, beside metabolic, physiological, transcriptional and anatomical spaces, and an action space generalizes from it to any space of some number of dimensions. These spaces are constructs a system makes to organize its activity: a model that captures how the positions of objects covary as an organism moves is a model of ordinary 3D space.
statements.scope: space as a cognitive construct. What physical space is lies outside the program

sources.quote: The notion of an action space generalizes from the familiar 3D space of moving behavior to any arbitrary space of some number of dimensions, within which an agent can act.
These spaces are constructs created by the system itself to organize its activity
A model that captures this covariance is a model of an ordinary 3D space.
